tasks.title: Integrate RM04 scheduler ingress, durable outcome delivery and original recovery
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver the concrete existing RM04 consumption adapter into the common programmatic event port and durable application-to-Management progress/outcome path. Acknowledge only committed durable/recoverable responsibility; never hold inbox/native callback transaction for full job execution. Notifications are bounded per-run/reference prompts, not4MiB fanout envelopes or execution authority; startup/reconnect/uncertain handoff rescan authoritative runs. Stage outcome intent beside business effects/original RM03 result in the application's original protected RM02 context where supported; already-entered work settles without synchronous Management reporting and committed delivery survives closed new-work admission. Recover the same run/operation/capsule through commit acknowledgement loss, takeover and compatible build replacement; preserve recorded failure/cancellation and unknown, no business replay by default. A declared consumer checkpoint proves protected safe-boundary continuation and incompatible upgrade/rollback refusal, without generic checkpoint machinery. Owns RM09-AC17 and RM10-AC08, RM10-AC14, RM10-AC15, RM10-AC16, RM10-AC17, RM10-AC18, RM10-AC19, RM10-AC20, RM10-AC22, RM10-AC23, RM10-AC31, RM10-AC36, RM10-AC37, RM10-AC38, RM10-AC39, RM10-AC40.
tasks.validation: Reuse actual owned PostgreSQL/RabbitMQ/HTTPS and existing Coordination/Operations/Messaging process fixtures for transactional ingress/outbox, lost notification/restart rescan, one original committed effect, unknown commit, ordered/late reports, graceful old build and forced compatible replacement/checkpoint. Verify both applications' real native authority/guard and joined callback/provider/drain ownership; no remote rollback inference. Document exact handoff/retry/result/protection ownership and unverified external failover boundaries. Include meaningful focused native/unit or browser checks for this implementation, affected documentation, and proportionate independent review; preserve failures and actual joined cleanup. Do not turn authored tests or reused evidence from different source bytes into a pass. Verify this owner consumes only the declared medium prerequisites (WORK-157, WORK-158, WORK-160, WORK-161, WORK-162) and keeps the original parent accounting pool; broad provenance containers are not early completion prerequisites.
